comment: Shared centred-window contract for custom mode with Centre ticked. The Windows (PowerShell Get-CentredRect) and macOS (JXA centredRect) implementations are both asserted against this table. The size is kept as given; odd leftovers round towards the top-left; a window bigger than the work area is pinned to its top-left so the title bar stays on screen.

cases.name: even fit on a 1920x1040 work area at the origin
odd leftover rounds towards the top-left
work area below a top taskbar or menu bar
secondary monitor right of the primary
negative-origin monitor left of and above the primary
exactly the size of the work area
bigger than the work area is pinned to its top-left, size kept
wider but shorter than the work area stays centred top to bottom
